verdicts.one_liner: Ira Domini now chains Ricochet/Split Shot; still the better gun-carry slot than Haze.
verdicts.direct: Ira Domini now works with Ricochet and splits into 3 bolts, raising his late ceiling; his vitality items are untouched.
verdicts.indirect: Weakening Headshot shred trimmed -13->-12%, a small relative loss to Hollow Point buyers. The tempo meta still ends games before his tank items fully come online.
build_adjustments: Keep Battle Vest as the first buy; Weakening Headshot into gun lanes is still correct.

verdicts.one_liner: Fixation buff lifts her early-mid damage; weak T4 gun items still cap her ceiling.
verdicts.direct: Fixation headshot stacks 2->3 and higher T3 weapon scaling raise her early-mid damage.
verdicts.indirect: Gun-cycle smoothing helps her M1 tempo, but Plated Armor blocking on-hit spirit and weak T4 gun items cap her late game.
build_adjustments: Play the cheap-attack-speed Fixation build; treat the Ricochet Tesla pivot as a fallback only.

verdicts.one_liner: On-hit spirit Wraith gutted: Magnum cut and Plated Armor now blanks Full Auto.
verdicts.direct: Card Trick heal 75->60, heal scaling 0.75->0.5, resist shred -8->-7% (T3 -5->-4%) and T3 Clubs slow cut.
verdicts.indirect: Mercurial Magnum cut (25->20%, 0.49->0.38), Plated Armor blocking Full Auto's spirit damage, and Spiritual Overflow's nerf delete her core build.
build_adjustments: If you must play her, rebuild pure sustain-gun or utility and respect Plated Armor buyers.

verdicts.one_liner: Patch's clearest casualty: gun stats, flask, Willpower and both T4 finishers cut.
verdicts.direct: Bullet dmg/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit scaling 0.25->0.21, flask range/speed -30%, and Willpower T3 spirit scaling and debuff resist cut.
verdicts.indirect: Mercurial Magnum and Spiritual Overflow are both gutted and Veil Walker lost Sprint Boots, removing his gun-curve ceiling.
build_adjustments: Skip Mercurial Magnum and Spiritual Overflow; either spike earlier or leave him benched.

verdicts.one_liner: Knives current-HP and alt-fire buffed into the tank wave; only regen items trimmed.
verdicts.direct: Alt fire base damage +4% and per-boon +0.24; Serrated Knives now deals 3.5% current-HP on impact at full rage.
verdicts.indirect: Radiant Regeneration (97% core) and Restorative Locket trims hit his sustain core, and Tankbuster 8->7.5% softens his anti-tank slot.
build_adjustments: Keep the spirit-regen core; lean on current-HP knives into the S-tier frontline.

verdicts.one_liner: Light-melee and heal scaling up; mobile burst assassin stays A in a tempo meta.
verdicts.direct: Crimson Slash T3 adds +0.4 heal spirit scaling, and Flying Slash light-melee scaling rises 1.0->1.2.
verdicts.indirect: Tankbuster 8->7.5% trims her late anti-tank luxury, but the Refresher-Unstoppable windows still suit the tempo meta.

verdicts.one_liner: Unchanged, but the tank/tempo meta eats her burst and Yamato owns her niche.
verdicts.indirect: The tank/sustain frontline and tempo meta negate her single-target burst, and no item change lifts her. Effectively benched until a rework.

verdicts.one_liner: Quick-scope carbine gutted; only the max-range sniper path now survives.
verdicts.direct: Kinetic Carbine min-damage multiplier 25->10% and no longer scaled by T3 kills the cheap close-range poke.
verdicts.indirect: Slowing Hex cd 27->29s trims her pick setup, and the tempo meta keeps punishing a stationary sniper.
build_adjustments: Commit to the max-range HVR/Sharpshooter sniper line; abandon the quick-scope carbine poke.

verdicts.one_liner: Comeback gutting punishes his slow split-push scaling; Toxic Bullets is a small offset.
verdicts.indirect: Gutted comeback souls and the now-competitive early Rift end games before his scaling map play comes online; the Toxic Bullets scaling buff barely offsets it.
build_adjustments: Play for earlier tempo; do not bank on late split-push scaling.

verdicts.one_liner: Gun build lost its capstone; Dashfernus and the Toxic Bullets buff carry him.
verdicts.indirect: Spiritual Overflow's nerf (spirit 40->30, fire rate 30->25%) hurts his burn-gun line; the Toxic Bullets spirit scaling buff offsets slightly.
build_adjustments: Lean Dashfernus; move the gun build off Spiritual Overflow toward Toxic Bullets and Swift Striker.

verdicts.one_liner: Buffs plus longer-CC picks suit her; only her Veil Walker disengage is gone.
verdicts.direct: Crackshot T2 adds -6% bullet res, health/boon 41->43, and Lasso extends +1->+1.25s.
verdicts.indirect: The tempo meta and the 35->38s 20m respawn make her picks worth more; the Veil Walker strip removed her core disengage.
build_adjustments: Replace the Veil Walker disengage; try the buffed Shadow Weave into Sprint Boots.

verdicts.one_liner: Early melee bruiser built for the tempo patch; only small item trims land.
verdicts.indirect: Trophy Collector 18->16 souls/min and the Veil Walker nerf trim his anti-heal build, but the tempo/early-bruiser meta keeps his floor high.

verdicts.one_liner: Lane-bully frontline with buffed Lifestrike and Fortitude; rising Shiv is the risk.
verdicts.indirect: Lifestrike buffed (120+1.75, 35% heal, slow now drags flyers) and Fortitude regen up, while the tempo meta rewards his lane-bully snowball; anti-tank Shiv rising is the main threat.
